messages:
yana: FYI starting RC creation for search-embed service. planned cut 08:45 PT. will run a quick litmus and a 15% canary. who can own sign-off?
elliot: I can. what's the artifact tag?
yana: tag is search-embed@2026-03-23-rc4
deploy-bot: Candidate created: search-embed@2026-03-23-rc4 (id: cand-1795550001). CI reports one warning: checksum mismatch during registry copy.
joel: checksum mismatch? did the build pipeline repackage assets?
marta: I re-ran the publish step, uploaded a corrected tarball. new tag search-embed@2026-03-23-rc4b, artifact id cand-1795550001-2.
deploy-bot: Candidate updated to search-embed@2026-03-23-rc4b (id: cand-1795550001b). All CI checks green. KV warm recommended.
qa-bot: Running litmus (cand-1795550001b). smoke set + rerank checks. ETA ~7m.
qa-bot: Litmus initial report: 119/120 pass, one rerank regression. linked examples in CI.
elliot: paste sample?
qa-bot: sample: input "Find invoices" expected top result invoice-123 actual invoice-321. looks like reranker threshold drift.
joel: that matches a recent default tweak in staging config. can we apply a runtime override on candidate?
marta: applying runtime config override: reranker.threshold=0.70 on cand-1795550001b. Audit: cfg-1795.
ops-bot: Override applied.
qa-bot: Rerun litmus: 120/120 pass :white_check_mark:.
yana: proceed to KV warm + 15% canary. command:
``
./deployctl kv-warm --candidate=cand-1795550001b --ttl=1h
./deployctl traffic-split --candidate=cand-1795550001b --pct=15
``
deploy-bot: KV warm started, traffic-split 15%.
infra-monitor: Observing p95/p99 during warm. initial metrics stable.
elliot: propose pinning for 90m promo window and reserve rollback slot. Abort rule: sustained error_rate >0.6% for 4m.
sheriff: acknowledged, i'll monitor.
yana: pinned candidate as pin-1795550001b, promo window 09:15-10:45 PT. RB ticket RB-7701 created.
ops-bot: Reminder: 20m radio silence before promotion start.
-- 09:18 PT --
deploy-bot: Promotion initiated for cand-1795550001b -> prod, rolling in 4 cohorts.
infra-monitor: Cohort 1 (5%) steady.
infra-monitor: Cohort 2 (20%) brief latency bump in apac-region at t+90s, traced to an overloaded cache node; cache autoscale +1 triggered.
marta: scaling cache node pool in apac.
ops-bot: Autoscale done. metrics normalizing.
sheriff: hold lifted.
yana: continue rollout.
deploy-bot: Cohort 3 (60%) promoted. Cohort 4 (100%) starting.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete: cand-1795550001b -> prod :shipit:
yana: promo looks good. ryan please add a short release note in RB-7701: mention the artifact re-upload and reranker override.
ryan: Added note: "search-embed RC4b promoted to prod. Re-uploaded artifact after checksum fix; applied reranker.threshold=0.70 override to maintain ranking parity. No model swap."
yana: thanks all, closing thread. :tada:
